name: Metolazone
summary: The cited US label reports diuretic activity at low GFR, but warns of accumulation in severe renal impairment. Anuria is a contraindication. Discontinue if azotemia and oliguria worsen. No numerical CKD adjustment is specified here, and US formulation instructions do not establish the Philippine Metoz regimen [[USPI]].
kidney_function_basis: No CKD dosing bands are inferred from historical study CrCl values.
hd: No chronic HD regimen established in the cited source. Anuria remains a contraindication [[USPI]].
pd: No PD regimen established in the cited source [[USPI]].
crrt: No CRRT regimen established in the cited source [[USPI]].
dialyzable: The US overdose section states that dialysis is unlikely to be effective; this is not a chronic dialysis dosing instruction [[USPI]].
monitoring: Electrolytes, renal function, blood pressure and clinical volume status, particularly with loop diuretics [[USPI]].

sources.citation: Sandoz Inc. Metolazone Tablets, USP. US prescribing information, revised February 2024; DailyMed updated March 19, 2025. Set ID0b619826-2567-49d7-8972-b6da5e4467df. Verified 2026-11-25. US formulation; not a Philippine Metoz insert.
